title: Recursive Self-Improvement on a Budget: Scoring Code Edits Before They Run
title_zh: 预算内的递归自我改进：在代码编辑运行前为其评分

paragraphs.en: A coding agent that rewrites its own scaffold has to choose which proposed edit to expand before that edit has been evaluated, and the search then has to return one agent. Each run fits one linear readout on the parent’s steering-split solve rate and eight coordinates of the proposed diff, from 96 scaffold edits labeled by four evaluations of a 16-instance fit split, and then freezes the coefficients. HumanEval+ reserves 48 instances as the steering split and Polyglot reserves 64. That split scores parents and keeps an archive of four nodes. Huxley–Gödel Machine selection draws a parent by Thompson sampling on the steering counts of nodes that have already been evaluated, and it expands the child that parent proposes. Every method then returns the earliest evaluated node whose steering-split solve count is maximal. The tables report the held-out score of that node on the other 100 HumanEval+ instances and the other 145 Polyglot instances, next to the root scaffold and the calibration edit with the highest fit-split label. Twelve runs of GPT-4o return a node at 87.0% on held-out HumanEval+, against 84.2% for the parent-rate ablation. On that split Huxley–Gödel Machine selection returns 85.1%, the root is at 81.2%, and the calibration-best edit is at 82.8%. On the same split Claude Sonnet 4.5 returns 86.6%, beside 86.5% for Huxley–Gödel Machine selection, 85.3% for the parent-rate ablation, and 85.1% for the calibration-best edit.

paragraphs.en: A coding agent that rewrites its own scaffold has to rank the edits it proposes before any of them has been evaluated, because the checker runs on one child per keep step and the child that is kept becomes a parent of the edits that follow. The Darwin Gödel Machine adds a child to its archive only after that child has been evaluated, and it samples parents from observed scores ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . The Huxley–Gödel Machine draws a parent by Thompson sampling on the success and failure counts of evaluated nodes and expands the child that parent proposes ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . AIDE scores a candidate after the evaluator has run it ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) . The readout is that kind of predictor, applied to the diff before the child is expanded. It is a linear score on the parent’s steering-split solve rate and eight coordinates of the diff. paragraphs.en: The held-out splits are the 100 HumanEval+ instances and the 145 Polyglot instances that remain after the 16-instance fit split and the steering split ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2021 ; Gauthier, 2024 ) . The steering splits contain 48 and 64 instances. Claude Sonnet 4.5 ( claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 ) and GPT-4o ( gpt-4o-2024-08-06 ) are fit separately and run separately. Each cell is twelve runs. Each run draws its own projection, calibrates its own coefficients on its own 96 edits, and draws its own proposals. Proposals are decoded at temperature 1.0 1.0 and the scaffold’s solutions at 0.2 0.2 . In four-fold cross-validation on each run’s calibration edits, the fitted score ranks the measured labels at Spearman ρ \rho between 0.18 0.18 and 0.34 0.34 across the four settings. Every run of every method spends the same number of checker evaluations: 9,280 on Polyglot and 8,496 on HumanEval+. A run of the readout or of the ablation spends 6,144 of them labeling the calibration edits, 1,536 on Polyglot or 1,152 on HumanEval+ evaluating the 24 calibration parents on the steering split, 64 or 48 evaluating the root, and the rest on its 24 keep steps. Huxley–Gödel Machine selection evaluates the root and expands 144 children on Polyglot and 176 on HumanEval+, reaching the same totals. The calibration stage is itself a search: the edit with the highest measured label is a candidate agent, and Table 1 reports it as the calibration-best baseline. After the keep steps, the readout, the parent-rate ablation, and Huxley–Gödel Machine selection each return one node, the earliest evaluated node whose steering-split solve count is maximal. Table 1 is the held-out score of that node, of the root, and of the calibration-best edit. Table 2 is the held-out score of the child the readout and the parent-rate ablation expand at step 1. Printed means and run standard deviations follow the aggregation protocol in Appendix B . A paired interval is the 95% Student interval on the twelve run-wise differences, with eleven degrees of freedom. The one-sided permutation probability is the fraction of the 4096 sign flips whose signed sum is at least the observed sum.
paragraphs.zh: 保留集划分是 100 个 HumanEval+ 实例和 145 个 Polyglot 实例，即扣除 16 个实例的拟合划分和引导划分后剩余的部分（Liu et al., 2023；Chen et al., 2021；Gauthier, 2024）。 引导划分分别包含 48 个和 64 个实例。 Claude Sonnet 4.5（claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929）和 GPT-4o（gpt-4o-2024-08-06）分别独立拟合、独立运行。 每个单元格是十二次运行。 每次运行抽取自己的投影，在自己的 96 个编辑上校准自己的系数，并抽取自己的候选方案。 候选方案以温度 1.0 1.0 解码，而脚手架的解答以 0.2 0.2 解码。 在对每次运行的校准编辑做四折交叉验证时，拟合出的分数在四种设置下对实测标签的 Spearman ρ \rho 介于 0.18 0.18 和 0.34 0.34 之间。 每种方法的每次运行花费相同数量的检查器评估次数：Polyglot 上为 9,280 次，HumanEval+ 上为 8,496 次。 读出或消融的一次运行中，有 6,144 次用于标注校准编辑，1,536 次（Polyglot）或 1,152 次（HumanEval+）用于在引导划分上评估 24 个校准父节点，64 次或 48 次用于评估根节点，其余用于其 24 个保留步骤。 Huxley–Gödel 机器选择评估根节点并分别在 Polyglot 上扩展 144 个子节点、在 HumanEval+ 上扩展 176 个子节点，达到相同的总数。 校准阶段本身就是一个搜索：实测标签最高的编辑是一个候选智能体，表 1 将其作为校准最优基线报告。 保留步骤之后，读出、父节点率消融和 Huxley–Gödel 机器选择各自返回一个节点，即最早被评估的、引导划分解题数达到最大的节点。 表 1 是该节点、根节点以及校准最优编辑的保留集分数。 表 2 是读出和父节点率消融在第 1 步所扩展的子节点的保留集分数。 打印的均值和运行标准差遵循附录 B 中的聚合协议。 配对区间是对十二个运行差异的 95% Student 区间，自由度为十一。 单侧置换概率是 4096 次符号翻转中带符号和至少不小于观测和的比例。

paragraphs.en: Gödel machines accept a self-rewrite only after a proof of higher expected utility ( Schmidhuber, 2007 ) . Good (1966) and Clune (2019) discuss ultraintelligent machines and AI-generating algorithms. The Self-Taught Optimizer (STOP), Automated Design of Agentic Systems (ADAS), and the Self-Improving Coding Agent (SICA) edit a scaffold or a codebase; SICA reports 17% to 53% on a random SWE-bench Verified subset ( Zelikman et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Robeyns et al., 2025 ) . The Gödel Agent searches a space of agent designs ( Yin et al., 2025 ) . With Claude 3.5 Sonnet (new), DGM reports 20.0% to 50.0% on a staged SWE-bench subset ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Wang et al. report 56.7% on SWE-Verified-60 with a different generator ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . In Table 1 that parent draw runs for the full horizon, and the reported node is the earliest evaluated node whose steering-split solve count is maximal. Liu et al. report 78.3% on SWE-Verified-60 and 93.3% on Polyglot with Qwen3.6-35B-A3B ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Lai et al. aggregate descendant outcomes into clade-level Beta beliefs and select nodes by Thompson sampling ( Lai et al., 2026 ) . AIDE scores a candidate only after an evaluator runs it, and AIDE 2 keeps a self-rewrite only after a hidden evaluation ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Srikanth et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 哥德尔机只有在证明了更高的期望效用后才会接受自我重写（Schmidhuber, 2007）。 Good（1966）与 Clune（2019）讨论了超智能机器与生成人工智能的算法。 自学优化器（STOP）、智能体系统自动设计（ADAS）与自我改进编码智能体（SICA）都会编辑脚手架或代码库；SICA 在随机抽取的 SWE-bench Verified 子集上报告了 17% 到 53% 的成绩（Zelikman et al., 2023；Hu et al., 2024；Robeyns et al., 2025）。 哥德尔智能体在智能体设计的空间中进行搜索（Yin et al., 2025）。 使用 Claude 3.5 Sonnet（新版本）时，DGM 在分阶段的 SWE-bench 子集上报告了 20.0% 到 50.0% 的成绩（Zhang et al., 2026）。 Wang 等人使用不同的生成器在 SWE-Verified-60 上报告了 56.7% 的成绩（Wang et al., 2026）。 在表 1 中，该父节点抽取会运行整个时程，而所报告的节点是其引导集解题数最大的最早被评估的节点。 Liu 等人使用 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在 SWE-Verified-60 上报告了 78.3%、在 Polyglot 上报告了 93.3% 的成绩（Liu et al., 2026）。 Lai 等人将后代结果聚合为分支级别的 Beta 信念，并通过汤普森采样来选择节点（Lai et al., 2026）。 AIDE 只有在评估器运行候选方案之后才对其进行打分，而 AIDE 2 只有在隐藏评估之后才保留自我重写（Jiang et al., 2025；Srikanth et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: The readout ranks scaffold diffs by the parent’s steering-split solve rate and by eight coordinates of the diff, and every method returns the earliest evaluated node whose steering-split solve count is maximal.
